requirements.statement: Spaces are not used to separate the letters of a word.

citations.quote: Les espaces ne sont pas utilisées pour séparer les lettres d’un mot ;

routes.statement: No word is written with spaces between its letters.

requirements.statement: Spaces are not used to simulate tables.

citations.quote: Les espaces ne sont pas utilisées pour simuler des tableaux ;

routes.statement: No table is simulated with spaces.

citations.quote: Pour simuler des tableaux ou des colonnes.

requirements.statement: Spaces are not used to simulate columns of text.

citations.quote: Les espaces ne sont pas utilisées pour simuler des colonnes de texte.

routes.statement: No column of text is simulated with spaces.

citations.quote: Pour simuler des tableaux ou des colonnes.

rationale.text: The test has three requirements, each a use of spaces that is forbidden: between the letters of a word, to simulate a table, to simulate columns of text. Each turns on the purpose of the spaces, which is judgment. A run of single letters separated by spaces may be a word spelled out for effect, or initials, a list of letters, a code or a formula; only someone who reads the language can tell it is a word. Runs of spaces may align a simulated table or columns, or be ordinary content such as preformatted code, verse or ASCII art. The methodology also mentions spaces used for margins or alignment, under the same judgment. No mechanical fault proves any requirement violated under every reading, so no check is registered and the entry is none. No axe rule is tagged. Applicability is judgment: the test concerns the use of spaces in a page, and whether a page uses spaces in any way the test examines is not something code decides. Needs is empty: the methodology disables styles, which a check could do on the page as loaded, and nothing calls for interaction.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, l’utilisation des espaces vérifie-t-elle ces conditions ?
Pour créer des effets de marges ou d’alignement ;
